_schema.note: Curated to federal-health-IT-relevant agencies. Each entry includes the official forecast URL plus our read on data accessibility (HTML-only, downloadable, or API). Every URL below was re-opened on 2026-10-19; where an agency's page has moved, gone dark or now blocks scripts, the entry says so and points at where the forecast actually lives now. acquisition.gov's cross-agency hub was itself updated 09/28/2026 and now lists 22 agency links.

agencies.format: Governmentwide FCO tool (filter Agency = Department of Veterans Affairs). Searchable, CSV export, JSON behind the UI
agencies.cadence: Continuous; VA rows were last re-pulled 2026-09-10 (rows then touched as recently as 2026-09-04). The tool is a browser-only app, so the 2026-10-19 check confirmed the page, not the row count
agencies.mmt_note: VA publishes its forecast into the governmentwide Forecast of Contracting Opportunities tool that GSA hosts (688 VA rows on 2026-09-10, 607 of them from the Technology Acquisition Center). VA's own query tool at vendorportal.ecms.va.gov/eVP/FCO/fco.aspx now says it covers fiscal year 2027, still at version 26.3.0.0 with the same reviewed stamp of 05/07/2026, so the fiscal-year label rolled over without a review. The old OSDBU acquisition page (va.gov/osdbu/acquisition/), which acquisition.gov's hub still links, returned 403 again on 2026-10-19.

agencies.format: Downloadable Excel (Long Range Acquisition Forecast) linked from Working with DHA
agencies.cadence: Annual; the posted file is still the FY2025 forecast (workbook modified 2025-05-22), re-checked 2026-10-19
agencies.mmt_note: dha.mil sits behind a bot challenge, so the workbook only downloads in a real browser. On 2026-10-19 the Working with DHA page still links only the FY25 LRAF under Items of Interest; no FY26 or FY27 forecast has been posted. Map any DHA line to the post-reorg PAE that will own it.

agencies.agency: Department of Health and Human Services (all OpDivs)
agencies.format: SBCX web app (mysbcx.hhs.gov redirects here). The Opportunity Forecast is a view inside the app, filterable by OpDiv and contracting office, with a JSON export behind the UI. The direct /industry/opportunity-forecast address linked in September now returns 404 outside the app
agencies.cadence: Continuous, but OpDivs refresh unevenly: on the 2026-09-10 export CMS, IHS and FDA carried FY26/FY27 rows while CDC, NIH and the Office of the Secretary (ASA/PSC) still showed FY24/FY25 dates. The export could not be re-pulled by script on 2026-10-19
agencies.mmt_note: HHS's unified small-business forecast across CMS, NIH, ARPA-H, CDC, FDA, IHS and ONC. 5,375 published rows on 2026-09-10, 3,928 of them IHS. Open the app, go to the Opportunity Forecast, and filter by OpDiv; NIH's own OAMP page points here as the NIH Procurement Forecast. acquisition.gov's hub links mysbcx.hhs.gov/#search-opportunities, which lands on the same app.

agencies.format: Downloadable Excel (Forecast of Opportunities), updated around the first of every month
agencies.cadence: Monthly; current file is dated 1 October 2026 (45 rows, down from 51 in September)
agencies.mmt_note: The workbook lives under Work With Us > Business Resources > Contract Opportunities, and the page itself says it is updated monthly around the first of every month. Each month's file URL redirects to the newest file (the 1 September 2026 address now serves the 1 October 2026 workbook), so an old link never breaks and never shows you the old month. CMS also mirrors a subset into HHS SBCX.

agencies.format: Forecast Tool on the Acquisition Gateway (replaced forecast.gsa.gov, which no longer resolves). Searchable, CSV export. gsa.gov's own forecast page moved again on the way: gsa.gov/small-business/forecast-of-contracting-opportunities, the address acquisition.gov's hub now lists, redirects to gsa.gov/small-business/find-opportunities, which points at this Forecast Dashboard
agencies.cadence: Continuous; 9,219 rows governmentwide on 2026-09-10, 391 of them GSA's own. Not re-counted 2026-10-19 because the tool is browser-only
agencies.mmt_note: GSA's own rows cover FAS, PBS and OCIO buys plus assisted acquisitions GSA runs for other agencies (HHS OIG cloud, HHS MSO). Governmentwide vehicles (OASIS+, Alliant 3, MAS) show up here before SAM.gov.

agencies.agency: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health
agencies.format: HTML program announcements (no procurement forecast); solicitations posted on SAM.gov
agencies.cadence: Rolling; new programs announced throughout the year. The page shows no posted or close dates
agencies.mmt_note: ARPA-H does not publish a forecast and has no rows in HHS SBCX. On 2026-10-19 the open list is Emerging Health Innovators, FASTPASS, UNIQUE, SURPASS, SPECTRA, ASCENT-IBO and the four rolling Mission Office ISOs; REST, STREAM and the TIGAR exploratory topic have dropped off since September. None is a procurement forecast row. Set a recurring check here rather than on the acquisition.gov hub.

agencies.format: Web app with structured filters and CSV export
agencies.mmt_note: DHS APFS is the gold-standard federal forecast UX. Loaded on 2026-10-19 (anticipated actions over $350,000; browse all records plus email notifications). Not health-relevant directly, but worth watching as the format other agencies emulate.

Each Service medical department (Army MEDCOM, AFMS, BUMED) maintains its own forecast linked from the DoD hub. business.defense.gov returned 403 to this session on 2026-10-19, with a browser user agent and without one; acquisition.gov's hub (updated 09/28/2026) still lists this address, so open it in a real browser before calling it dead.
